CustomField.description: How many reminder emails have been sent to the interviewer to record the mock's Human_Decision. 0 = none, 1 = first sent (interviewer only, at mock end + 4 hours), 2 = second sent (interviewer + assigned trainer, at mock end + 7 hours). CustomField.inlineHelpText: Number of result-reminder emails sent (0, 1, or 2). Auto-managed by MockDeadlineEnforcer.
